On Friday morning, there are 18 pink flamingos and 0 white flamingos.

On Saturday morning, the neighbors take back one third of the flamingos. One third of 18 is 6. They take 6 pink flamingos, paint them white, and return them. Now there are \(18 - 6 = 12\) pink flamingos and 6 white flamingos.

On Sunday morning, they add 18 pink flamingos. Now there are \(12 + 18 = 30\) pink flamingos and still 6 white flamingos.

At noon on Sunday, the difference is \(30 - 6 = 24\) more pink flamingos than white flamingos.

Answer: 24
